reaction.title: Chemical Reaction
reaction.instruction: Combine elements to observe their chemical reactions and see what compounds they form.

electrical.title: Electrical Conductivity
electrical.instruction: Test how different elements conduct electricity and learn about conductors versus insulators.

electrochemical.title: Electrochemical Cell
electrochemical.instruction: Build an electrochemical cell and observe electron flow between electrodes.

nuclear.title: Nuclear Reactions
nuclear.instruction: Explore nuclear fission and fusion processes with interactive atomic models.

organic.title: Organic Chemistry
organic.instruction: Build organic molecules and learn about carbon-based compounds and their structures.

crystal.title: Crystal Structures
crystal.instruction: Examine how atoms arrange themselves in crystal lattices and discover different crystal systems.
